title: galium gracile var. anglicum
intro: Galium gracile var. anglicum, commonly known as English bedstraw, is a plant species native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of English bedstraw include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as soothing digestive issues and promoting relaxation. The health benefits of English bedstraw may include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and stress.
